Instructions: Answer the following question about drug properties.
Context: Repetitive exposure to a chemical agent can induce an immune reaction in inherently susceptible individuals that leads to skin sensitization.
Question: Given a drug SMILES string and its functional groups, predict whether it
(A) does not cause a skin reaction (B) causes a skin reaction
Drug SMILES: <SMILES>CCOC(=O)C(=NOC(C)(C)C(=O)OC(C)(C)C)c1csc(NC(c2ccccc2)(c2ccccc2)c2ccccc2)n1</SMILES>
Please think step by step and use tools when necessary (**Don't use the same tool more than once**). Then put your final choice ((A) or (B)) after "Answer:"
